info.name: DA Registry API (local + dev)
info.description:
DA Registry APIs for DA Services (local stack). Variables point at the local stack (docs/da-services-local-setup.md). Phase 1: build on the Partner API folder (push, status, exceptions, DCI search); the Staff API folders need a user's Keycloak token (login decision pending). Dev: staff portal https://da-registry.development.oanstaging.com; the partner API public host on dev is not available yet (requested from DevOps), and partner signature/consent checks are on there.

Environments: import `da-registry-local.postman_environment.json` or `da-registry-dev.postman_environment.json` and select one at the top right. Then run folder `0. Login` (dev: the three 0-dev requests; local: 0-local).

item.name: 0. Login
item.description:
Run ONE of the two options before anything else.

DEV (deployed): send 0-dev-a, 0-dev-b, 0-dev-c in order (or right-click the folder > Run). They do the same browser sign-in the Staff Portal does (Keycloak form -> IAM callback) and save token + csrf into the environment. The token lives 5 minutes: when a request answers G2P-AUT-401, run the three again. Needs `username` and `password` in the dev environment (password is a secret field, type it in Postman, do not commit it).

LOCAL: send 0-local only (direct Keycloak token with admin/admin).

Three demo users for the two-level approval (local): 0-local-officer enters the DA, 0-local-validator approves Stage 1, 0-local-approver approves Stage 2. Switch the token by sending the matching request before each step.

request.description: Follows the redirect to Keycloak and keeps the login page. The test script saves the form action into `kc_login_action`. Postman stores the Keycloak session cookies automatically.

request.description: Two-level approval: this is Stage 1 (`current_stage: 1`). After it succeeds, AWE opens a Stage 2 task. Run 7 (new task id) and 9 (claim) again, then 10b.

Stage 2 of the two-level approval. Same body as the stage-1 request with `current_stage: 2` and the Stage 2 task id from 7. Approvers: Operations Administrator. Only after this stage does the submission reach the register.

Wait 15-30 s after the approval; the DA-ID may show as TEMP-… for a few seconds.

Note: approval is processed in the background. Wait about 10 seconds after request 10 (or 16) before sending this one, otherwise you get REGISTER_DATA_NOT_FOUND. The DA-ID appears in `functional_record_id` once assigned.

item.description: Two-level approval (standard, as in the farmer registry): Stage 1 then Stage 2, any one approver per stage. Order: 7 -> 9 -> 10 (stage 1) -> 7 -> 9 -> 10b (stage 2) -> wait ~10 s -> 11. Stage 1 approvers: Operations Administrator, Intake Validator (intake) / Data Validator (change request). Stage 2: Operations Administrator.

item.name: Staff API: bulk import (ingest one DA, or upload a file)
S16. Register a DA through the staff API (ingest-data, same body as 17)

request.description: The staff API's version of the partner push (17): same raw body (header + message), but with the signed-in user's token and CSRF instead of a partner signature. Permission intakeSubmission:edit (role Intake Officer). Response: response_payload.correlation_id. The DA is validated and sent to the two-level approval like a form submission (tasks in 6/7, approve with 10 and 10b); the DA-ID comes after the stage-2 approval. This is the phase-1 path for DA Services bulk import: one request per DA. On dev this answers REGP-ERR-001 PARTNER_NOT_REGISTERED until DA Services (header.sender_id da-services) is registered in Partner Management by DevOps; the form path (Single DA form folder) works on dev without it.

item.name: S17. Outcome of an ingest (search_in_ingestion_data by reference_id)

request.description: Platform view of an ingest: search_text matches anywhere in the raw payload, so the reference_id finds it. Returns the pipeline state (classification_status PROCESSED / FAILED, classification_latest_error_code, intake_form_submission_id, ingest_correlation_id), not the DA-ID. Permission incomingMessage:view (role Integration Manager). For DA-ID and a plain reason use 18 (/partner/da/status) on the partner API, or S13 with the submission's record.

request.description: Queues the uploaded file (data_model IMPORT_FILE). The worker turns each row into a submission and opens its approval request with the registry's service token. Then: 5 (list submissions) to see the rows, 4 (get submission) for awe_request_id, 7 -> 9 -> 10, 7 -> 9 -> 10b to approve, 11 for the DA-ID. Permission intakeSubmission:edit.

item.description:
Two ways to bring DAs in bulk through the staff API. Either path sends every DA through the two-level approval (folder Approval): nothing is auto-approved.

A) One DA per request: S16 (ingest-data), outcome with S17.
B) A whole Excel / CSV file: S18 upload, then S19 enqueue; rows appear in request 5 (list submissions, submission_source PARTNER) within 1-2 minutes, each with a stage-1 task in 6/7. A row with an unknown Kebele or a duplicate Fayda ID is rejected with the reason (S17, or 18b on the partner API).

request.description: Change fayda_id and reference_id for each push.

query.description: DUPLICATE_IDENTITY | INVALID_KEBELE | MISSING_MANDATORY_FIELD | INVALID_FIELD | REJECTED | FAILED_SYNC

request.description: Every DA that is stuck (DA Services pushes and file-import rows), with reason and exception_type. Only the latest attempt per record. correlation_id works with 18.
Also zone_code (e.g. ET0403). Codes are Master Data P-codes; always filter by code, names repeat.
DAs registered or changed (approved) after the given time. Use for incremental sync: run with the time of the last run.

Several filters in one query are combined with AND. This is the DARegistryClient.get_da_list() mapping: woreda->woreda_code, kebele->geo_lowest_level_value_id, education_tier->education_level, active_status->record_status, search->search_text. An empty query is rejected: send record_status ACTIVE to list all.

item.name: 24. Code list values (dropdowns: specialisation, position, qualification, prefix, gender, marital status, source)

request.description: Every DA dropdown reads its values from Master Data (the openg2p-data pack ETH-OAN). Same token as the staff API. attribute_id: DA_SPECIALISATION, DA_POSITION, DA_EDUCATION_LEVEL (qualification), DA_SOURCE, PREFIX, GENDER, MARITAL_STATUS. Save value_id on the DA (education_level, specialisation, position, prefix, gender, marital_status); show value_display. Do not hardcode the lists.
